loginHelp: You will approve a short code in Beacon. No password is typed here.
deviceHelp: We opened {uri} in your browser. Check that it shows this code, then approve.
deviceScope: The server refused the requested permissions.
sessionExpired: Your session ended. Sign in again.
noTasks: No tasks yet. When one is assigned to you, it lands here; the robot is keeping the seat warm.
offline: Offline — {count} action(s) will be sent when the connection returns.
offlineStartNote: When the connection returns, the times are sent as they happened.
dropped: {count} offline action(s) could not be applied.
featureIdleText: Your server does not set this, so it is your choice (off by default). When on, the app reads only your computer's "time since last input" counter, on this device, while a timer runs, and asks you after the chosen minutes. Nothing about your activity is sent: only your answer.
featureNotificationsText: When on, the app may show a system notification (for example when you come back while a timer runs), never outside the working hours published by your organisation.
featureAutostart: Start TimeTrack when I sign in to my computer
featureAutostartText: Off by default. When on, the app starts hidden in the tray when you sign in to your computer. It does not start a timer.
privacyIntro: TimeTrack only records the time you choose to track.
privacyNever: Screenshots, keystrokes, the applications or windows you use (with meeting detection on, only which meeting app holds the microphone is checked, on this computer), the pages you visit, your activity or idle state.
privacyRights: Your employer is responsible for the data on the server. You can see and export your entries in Beacon.
updateRequiredText: This version ({current}) is no longer supported by your server. Version {min} or later is required.
updateFailed: The automatic update failed: {message}. Download the new version from Beacon.
updateUnavailable: Your server asks for version {min} or later, but no compatible update is offered automatically. Download it from Beacon.
updateManual: Automatic updates are not available for this installation. Download version {version} from Beacon.
updateCardText: You have {current}. The update takes a moment and TimeTrack restarts by itself.
updateRunningText: A timer is running on {task}. Updating restarts TimeTrack; the timer keeps running in Beacon. Update now, or after you stop it?
updateWaiting: TimeTrack will update when you stop the timer.
updateCheckFailed: Could not check for updates right now. Try again later.
updateStoreManaged: Updates come from the Microsoft Store.
updateRequiredStore: This version ({current}) is no longer supported by your server. Update TimeTrack to version {min} or later from the Microsoft Store.
updateRequiredRunning: A timer is running on {task}. It keeps running in Beacon while TimeTrack restarts, or you can stop it first.
deviceUntrusted: The server sent a sign-in address on another site, so it was not opened. Open it yourself only if you trust it:
serverHelp: The address you use to open Beacon in your browser.
whereText: Open Beacon in your browser and copy the address from the address bar (for example https://beacon.example.com). It is also on Beacon → Tasks → Time → Apps, next to the download of this app.
urlInvalid: That does not look like a web address. Example: beacon.example.com
urlCredentials: Remove the user name and password from the address.
urlInsecure: Beacon must use https://. Type the address with https://.
errGenericText: Try again. If it keeps happening, copy the details for support.
errUnreachableText: Check the address and your connection. If you use a VPN, connect it.
errNotBeaconText: TimeTrack was not found at {host}. Check that it is the same address you use in the browser.
errNoDeviceFlowTitle: This server doesn't support device sign-in yet
errNoDeviceFlowText: {host} answers, but it cannot connect devices with a code. Ask your administrator to update Beacon (TimeTrack 1.9 or later).
errRateLimitedText: Wait a moment and try again.
errTaskForbiddenText: You no longer have access to this task or its board.
errScopeText: Connect this computer again to grant them.
errTimerRunningText: It was started on another device. Retry to see it.
errServerText: It is not your fault. Try again in a moment.
codeExpiry: Time left to approve the code
deviceExpiredText: Codes don't keep long: this one took a nap. Get a new code and approve it in Beacon.
deviceDeniedTitle: The connection was declined in Beacon
deviceDeniedText: If that was a mistake, try again and approve the code.
searchHint: ↑ ↓ to choose, Enter to start, Esc to clear
noResults: Nothing matches “{query}”, and the robot read the list twice. Only tasks you can track time on appear.
noRecent: Start a task and it will appear here. Pin the ones you use most.
shortcutHelp: Shows TimeTrack with the search open, from any app. Format: CommandOrControl+Alt+Shift+T.
shortcutFailed: Shortcut “{shortcut}” is in use or not valid — choose another.
aboutText: TimeTrack {version} for Beacon. Records only the time you choose to track.
stillThereTimeout: No rush. If there is no answer within {minutes} min, the timer pauses at your last activity and nothing is lost.
idleMeeting: I was in a meeting or call
idleDiscardMinutes: Drop those {minutes} min and keep going
idleKept: Got it, the time is kept.
idleDiscarded: Those minutes were left out. The timer keeps running.
idlePaused: Timer paused at your last activity.
idleNoteHelp: For example "Weekly sync". It is saved on this time entry.
awayText: It paused at {time}, your last activity on {task}. Welcome back whenever you are ready.
gapText: The timer paused at {from}, your last activity on {task}. You were away until {to} ({minutes} min). What should happen with that time?
gapUnsupported: Your server cannot add past time from the app. You can add it in Beacon if you need to.
idleOrgOn: Turned on by your organisation. While a timer runs, after {minutes} minutes without keyboard or mouse input the app asks whether you are still there. You can make it wait longer.
idleLocalOnly: The input counter is read on this computer only and is never stored or sent. Only your answer reaches the server.
clamp_start_overlap: {task} started at {applied} instead of {requested}, when your previous entry ended.
clamp_start_max_backdate: {task} started at {applied} instead of {requested}: your organisation does not allow adding time further back.
clamp_start_future: {task} started at {applied}: the requested time ({requested}) was in the future. Check this computer's clock.
clamp_start_disabled: {task} started at {applied} instead of {requested}: your organisation does not allow adding past time.
clamp_start_not_supported: {task} was recorded from {applied}, when the connection returned. It started at {requested}, but your server cannot record earlier starts.
clamp_stop_before_start: The timer stopped at {applied}, when it started, instead of {requested}.
clamp_stop_future: The timer stopped at {applied}: the requested time ({requested}) was in the future. Check this computer's clock.
clamp_stop_disabled: The timer stopped at {applied} instead of {requested}: your organisation does not allow earlier stop times.
clamp_stop_none: The timer stopped at {applied} instead of {requested}.
localDataCleared: Local data cleared. TimeTrack keeps nothing on this computer now.
privacySentSignIn: The device name you approve in Beacon, when you sign in.
privacySentTimer: The task you start, stop or switch to, the time you did it (also for actions sent later, after being offline), an optional note and the source "desktop".
privacySentIdle: Your answer to "Still there?": keep, discard, pause or count on another task, with the start and end of that time. Never the input counter.
privacySentUpdates: The app version, platform, architecture and installer kind when it checks for updates.
privacyLocalToken: The session token, in the system keychain.
privacyLocalState: The server address, your e-mail, the running timer, actions waiting to be sent, pinned tasks, the last task you tracked, an unsent meeting note, your settings with the date of each consent, and which friendly messages were shown lately (so they do not repeat).
privacyLocalIdle: The "time since last input" counter: read from the system every 30 seconds while a timer runs, used only to decide when to ask, never stored, logged or sent.
privacyLocalTotals: The Today and This week totals, computed here from your own entries.
clearLocalText: Signs you out and deletes everything TimeTrack keeps on this computer: the token, settings, consents, pinned tasks, actions waiting to be sent and the "Still there?" state. Your entries on the server are not touched.
clearLocalSure: Delete all TimeTrack data on this computer?
clearLocalPending: {count} action(s) have not reached the server yet and will be lost. Delete all TimeTrack data on this computer?
idleUserSwitch: Ask "Still there?" while a timer runs
idlePersonalText: On by default for your account. After {minutes} minutes without keyboard or mouse input the app asks whether you are still there. You can turn it off or make it wait longer.
savedC: Logged {time} on {task}. Good moment for a stretch?
savedOffline: {time} on {task} is saved on this computer and goes to Beacon when you are back online.
welcomeText: This computer is connected to {host}. Pick a task and press Start; I'll keep an eye on the clock.
longRunningText: {task} has been on the clock for {hours} hours. If you finished a while ago, stop it and fix the end time in Beacon.
idleHint: Nothing on the clock yet. Pick a task below and press Start.
storeAbout: Sit back: it handles them in the background.
themeHelp: System follows your computer's light or dark setting.
funMessagesHelp: A smile now and then: different ways of asking "Still there?", cheers after long stretches, an early start, Friday afternoon and the weekend.
wellbeingRemindersHelp: Gentle nudges for coffee, lunch, a stretch, some water, or calling it a day when it gets late. Never more than one every {minutes} minutes, always easy to dismiss.
friendlyLocal: Worked out on this computer from your timer and the time of day, in your Beacon language. Nothing is sent.
idleCountdown: The timer pauses in {time} if there is no answer.
idleStoppedAt: I stopped your timer at {time} on {task}.
promptEscapeHint: This question needs an answer: choose one of the options.
promptElsewhere: The question is open in its own window, in the middle of your screen.
nativeIntroTitle: Friendly messages now pop up on your desktop
nativeIntroText: They appear as desktop notifications (bottom right on Windows, top right on macOS, at the top on most Linux desktops), even with this window closed. Click one to come back here.
nativeOffText: Your system does not show TimeTrack's notifications, so the friendly messages stay inside this window. You can allow them in the system settings.
desktopNotificationsHelp: Outside the app, even with the window closed: bottom right on Windows, top right on macOS, at the top on GNOME. The "Still there?" question always opens in its own window in the middle of the screen.
nativeStatusDenied: Notifications are turned off for TimeTrack in your system settings: the messages show inside the app.
nativeStatusFailed: The system did not show the last notification: the messages show inside the app.
nativeStatusUnsupported: Desktop notifications are not available here: the messages show inside the app.
backgroundNote: Closing the window keeps TimeTrack running in the tray (the notification area on Windows, the menu bar on macOS): the timer, the "Still there?" check and the friendly messages carry on. Quit from the tray menu.
scheduleRemindersHelp: A note at your start time, at lunch and at the end of the day, with a button to start or stop the timer. None on holidays or vacations, and never hours late after the computer slept.
scheduleFromBeacon: Filled in from your working hours in Beacon. Change any value here: it applies to this computer only.
scheduleNoBeacon: Beacon does not publish working hours for you: set your own here (this computer only).
daysOffHelp: No schedule reminders on these days. Beacon's come from your organisation; add your own here.
scheduleLocal: Your changes and days off stay on this computer; nothing is sent to Beacon.
detailEmpty: Select a task to see its time here.
entriesUnavailable: This connection cannot read your entries: today’s and this week’s time are not available.
privacyLocalWindow: The size and position of the window in each view (compact and full).
browserHelp: Every link the app opens (Beacon pages, My time, the sign-in page) uses this browser. Saved on this computer only.
browserMissing: {name} is no longer installed here: links open in the system default browser.
browserFallback: {name} could not be found, so the link opened in the system default browser.
browserCustomInvalid: That file is not a browser this app can start. Choose the browser's program (.exe on Windows, .app on macOS).
openFailed: The browser could not be opened.
openFailedCopied: The browser could not be opened — link copied.
copyMyTimeLink: Copy the link to My time
privacyLocalBrowser: Which browser opens your links ("Open Beacon in"), and the path of a custom one.
reassignHeading: Which task does this time belong to?
reassignSearchFailed: The search did not work. Try again.
reassignEmpty: No pinned or recent tasks yet: search for one.
resumeShortcutHelp: Starts your last task again (a new entry) from any app, even with TimeTrack hidden in the tray. Default: Ctrl+Alt+T (⌘⌥T on macOS, Ctrl+Alt+Shift+R on Linux). Format: CommandOrControl+Alt+T.
shortcutSame: “{shortcut}” is already the other shortcut: choose a different one.
nudgeSwitch: Remind me when I work without a timer during my working hours
nudgeHelp: A friendly notification with “Start” and “Choose task”, at most once every 45 minutes, never on days off, at lunch or while friendly messages are paused. Keyboard and mouse activity is read only on this computer and is never stored or sent.
lockSwitch: Pause on screen lock or sleep
lockHelp: From the moment you lock the screen or the computer sleeps, the time counts as idle. When you come back you choose: keep it, discard it or reassign it. The lock signal never leaves this computer.
lockNeedsIdle: It works with the “Still there?” check, which is off now.
meetingToggle: Notice when I'm in a call and ask what to record it as
meetingHelp: Off by default. When a call in Teams, Zoom, Webex, Slack, a browser (Google Meet, Jitsi…) or a similar app has lasted a couple of minutes, TimeTrack asks which meeting it is, or offers your generic meeting task. When the call ends, it offers to go back to what you were doing.
meetingPrivacy: To notice a call, the app only checks, every 20 seconds on this computer, whether the microphone is in use and which meeting app is using it. It never reads window titles, web addresses, chats or audio, and nothing about it is stored or sent: only the timer you choose.
meetingGenericHelp: The task "Generic meeting" starts, for calls you don't want to name one by one.
meetingStatusApps: Now: the microphone is in use ({apps}).
meetingStatusOther: Now: the microphone is in use by an app that is not a meeting app.
meetingStatusUnavailable: This computer does not say whether the microphone is in use, so no calls are noticed.
meetingSearch: Search a task for this meeting
meetingGenericOnce: Pick your generic meeting task: it is remembered (you can change it in Settings).
meetingNoTasks: No tasks yet: search for one.
privacyLocalMeetings: With meeting detection on: whether the microphone is in use and which meeting app uses it (Teams, Zoom…, or "browser"), checked every 20 seconds; the call's start and end and the answer to the question stay in the app's local storage. Never window titles, web addresses, chats or audio; nothing of it is sent.
